Maya R: Heads-up: PolarBeam (Acct PB-192) hasn't paid INV-2026-0047 for $73,452.12 — due 2026-01-31. I tried email, no response. Thoughts on a 3-month installment plan? Need approval to offer and remove credit hold if they sign.
Luca H: Can you paste the invoice and last contact? Also what's their deployment? Are they on Dedicated?
Maya R: INV PDF: https://invoices.redwood/pb/INV-2026-0047.pdf. They’re on Dedicated (reserved capacity). We paused new provisioning as of 2026-02-10. Contact thread: acct+polarbeam@redwood -> email bounced once.
Olivia K: :grimacing: they hit a usage spike in Feb but usage dropped after the pause. Pulling txn history now.
Collections Bot: AUTOMATED: Aging summary for PB-192 — balance: $73,452.12, days past due: 53, last payment: 2025-11-15. Recommended steps: 7-day final notice, offer split 3x monthly ACH, escalate to legal if no response.
Samir D: If we unhold Dedicated we take on exposure. Proposal: require a deposit equal to 1 month (~$24k) + signed payment schedule before we lift hold.
Maya R: Counter-proposal: 30% upfront ($22,035.64) + 2 monthly equal payments for remainder. Require auto-ACH mandate and waive late fees if they adhere. Need approvals to send formal plan.
Luca H: I approve with conditions: must have a PO or signed schedule from their billing contact. Also add rollback automation: if any payment fails, automatic credit hold + API throttling.
Olivia K: Agree. I'll draft the customer-facing plan and email template. @Maya R can you confirm whether they prefer ACH or card? Also will loop in AE Sam T for negotiation.
Maya R: Customer replied to my chase: 'Open to installment, need internal approval. Please send a formal plan by EOD.' I'll loop AE Sam T now and forward all threads.
Samir D: Legal note: add explicit clause for immediate suspension of reserved capacity on second missed installment and right to accelerate remaining balance. I'll draft the clause.
Maya R: Action items: Olivia drafts plan + template, Samir adds termination/acceleration language, Luca signs off on rollback config, I send the plan and schedule a 7-day follow-up. If no response escalate to legal collections. :thumbsup:
